scenario.description: Ask for the airline pet policy.
messages: Are pets permitted on board and under what conditions?

transcript.text: Hello! How can I help you today?
Are pets permitted on board and under what conditions?

Yes. Small cats and dogs are permitted in the cabin if the combined weight of the pet and carrier is 8 kg or less. They must travel for the entire journey in an approved soft-sided carrier that fits under the seat, and cabin pet space is limited and must be requested in advance. Larger pets can travel in the aircraft hold on selected routes in an airline‑approved hard carrier, but we do not accept pets in the hold when temperatures or operational conditions make it unsafe. Trained assistance dogs travel free of charge, subject to documentation checks.

Tell me your route and travel date, the pet type and weight including the carrier, and whether you prefer cabin or hold so I can advise on availability and next steps.
